Implemented `solve(payload, config)` in `/Volumes/Models/ds4/.workspaces/server-agent-day-20261004/confirmation-visible/ledger/solution.py`.

It selects the winning event per exact key by highest revision, breaking ties by the last payload occurrence, emits winning puts in `live`, emits winning deletes in `deleted` only when `include_deleted` is true, sorts both lists by key using normal Python string ordering, preserves empty keys and JSON values, and does not mutate the inputs.
